overrides_applied.note: Each octant consists of five rigid sectors and four bellows assemblies -> 8 x 5 = 40 rigid PIECES (1975: 32). Same statement: Brochure p.12 (five rigid pieces and four sets of bellows); 1979 AR p.36 (all five of the rigid sectors for the prototype octant). Bellows total stays 8 x 4 = 32. Geometric interpretation (assumed): the 1975 octant was cut in the middle of its outermost rigid sectors (1975 p.299); in 1983 these two half-sectors are separate end pieces, so the 40 pieces still fill 32 pitches of 11.25 deg - see components_add vessel_octant_layout_1983. Three different rigid-sector types were made (1983 PR p.24).
Value unchanged; composition changed: octant = 5 rigid sectors + 4 bellows assemblies (1975: 4 + 4). Octants joined by renewable Inconel lip welds (p.24; p.17).
Bellows fabricated from Inconel 625 sheets of 2 mm thickness (1975 stress calc: 1.7 mm). 1979 AR p.36: dimensional changes to the bellows for wider manufacturing tolerances.

Table I: weight of vacuum vessel 108 t (1975: 68 t). Same 108 t in 1979 AR Table I p.15. CONTRADICTION: Brochure 1982 gives 100 t (p.6 table and p.13 vessel table). 108 t chosen as the later as-built report.
DERIVED 108 t / 8 = 13.5 t (not printed); with the Brochure 100 t it would be 12.5 t.
overall vessel resistance 0.6 mOhm (1975 table: 0.52 mOhm); high-resistivity Inconel 625 bellows chosen for this.
1975: Inconel 600 / Nicrofer 7216. Bellows remain Inconel 625 (p.24; Brochure p.13). Bellows flanges: 4 mm Nicrofer 7216 LC plates.
base pressure of 10^-10 torr required (1975: about 2 x 10^-10 Torr). A requirement, not a measured value; 1983 PR p.24 gives outgassing 10^-11 mbar l s^-1 cm^-2 instead.
Material changed: Microtherm insulation panels in two overlapping layers (1975: Triton Kaowool 2.5 cm). Thickness NOT stated in 1983 sources -> 1975 value 0.025 m kept as ASSUMPTION.

Now = front face of the 4 graphite limiter modules at the outer midplane, adjustable in the radial direction (p.24); the radius is NOT given in 1983 sources -> 1975 Re(plasma) 4.21 kept as ASSUMPTION. NB 1983 plasmas had radius ~1.1 m (p.13), so the real 1983 limiter setting may have been nearer ~4.1 m.
Table: Coil No.1 number of coils 8; text: The 8, essentially identical, inner coils (1975: 10). Also 8 blocks drawn in the coil-1 stack of 1979 AR Fig.12 p.33.
DERIVED 8 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 14 (1975: 16). Text p.15: six larger diameter outer coils; Wesson p.41: inner coil + six other coils.

1979 Fig.12 (layout of PF system, no printed dims): 8-coil stack spans 4.26 m (+-0.2), centred on the midplane; vertical scale calibrated on upper-arm top to lower-arm bottom = 11.42 m (base iron_core Z 5.79 / -5.63), midplane check within 0.05 m; horizontal scale of that figure is NOT consistent (schematic) -> vertical only. 4.26/8 = 0.533 m per coil (1975: 0.497 x 10 = 4.97 m). Per-coil turns/section for the 8-coil design NOT known.

Coil No.1 maximum current 40,000 A (1975: 34 kA); coils 2-4: 45,000 A each (1975: 34 / 11.8 / 13 kA) - winding designs of coils 2-4 therefore probably changed too, but turns are not given (not overridden).

Table I: weight of iron core 2800 t. CONTRADICTION: Brochure p.6 and p.18 give 2700 t; 1979 AR p.15 gives 2567 t (= 1975 extended-performance total); Wesson p.42 gives 2600 t; 1975 basic 2263 t. Part masses (limbs, arms) not re-stated -> base part masses left unchanged, so they no longer sum to this total.

Text p.16: inner cylinder with 32 flutes; shell split into 8 identical sectors. 1975 design: cast light alloy (Al) wedge blocks and Al-alloy plates - material changed; geometry of the shell not re-stated.

overrides_applied.name: vessel_octant_layout_1983
overrides_applied.note: Counts (5 + 4, three rigid types, +-3 mm radial tolerance) are TEXT (p.24). Widths are NOT given anywhere -> ASSUMED layout: keep the 1975 pitch 360/32 = 11.25 deg with the bellows between TF-coil pitches; the octant ends are two half-width end sectors (the 1975 octant joint lay in the middle of the outermost rigid sectors, 1975 p.299), which explains 5 pieces = 4 pitch-equivalents and three sector types (end / intermediate / middle-with-main-port). Bellows have parallel flanges (1975 p.295, p.303) so their toroidal length is constant (0.15 m, see vessel_bellows_length_estimate) and the rigid sectors are wedges: widths in deg derived at the plasma-side wall radii 4.389 (outboard) and 1.664 (inboard). Alternative reading (5 equal sectors of ~(45 - 4*bellows)/5 deg) is possible but would break the 32-fold symmetry of the TF coils; not used. Octant numbering origin/direction is NOT known: octant k assumed to span phi = 45(k-1)..45k deg.

overrides_applied.name: vessel_bellows_1983
overrides_applied.note: Text: bellows from Inconel 625 sheets of 2 mm thickness with bellows convolutions of 120 mm and 10 mm width of convolution; assemblies = two perforated 4 mm Nicrofer 7216 LC flanges welded to an inner and an outer bellows. INTERPRETATION (ours): 120 mm = convolution height (depth), 10 mm = width of one convolution; number of convolutions not stated. toroidal_length from vessel_bellows_length_estimate (digitized on the 1975 plan) - ASSUMED unchanged in 1983. Protective bellows shields still present (Brochure p.12) -> base limiters.bellows_shield_Re/Ri kept.

overrides_applied.name: vessel_bellows_length_estimate
overrides_applied.note: 1975 Fig. IV.1-9 (plan of the torus midplane, 1 m scale bar = 586 px at 600 dpi): double bellows 90-100 px = 0.155-0.17 m, rigid wall boxes 120-145 px; the plan is schematic (box + bellows sum 0.38-0.41 m vs 0.30-0.33 m pitch arc at R 1.54-1.66), so fraction of pitch 0.42 x 0.32 m = 0.135 m and direct scale 0.16 m -> 0.15 +- 0.03 m. 1975 design value; 1983 bellows had dimensional changes (1979 AR p.36) of unknown size.

overrides_applied.name: vessel_restraint_rings
overrides_applied.note: Text: modular restraint rings encircled the vessel, 1 m above and below the horizontal mid-plane, consisting of up to 90 mm thick outer skins of the rigid sectors and electrically insulated bridges across the bellows; they add toroidal rigidity. R_outer_skin_at_Z = 4.293 m DERIVED from jet1975 profiles/vessel_outer.csv at |Z| = 1.0. Which side (outboard assumed; inboard not excluded) and the poloidal band height (0.20 m) are ASSUMED.
